name: FASW Application
no_appearances_reason: The fed's own rulebook/application document; no match, angle or roster result is staged. The two weekly shows this document announces (FASW Saturday Night Riot, FASW Wednesday Wipeout) have no surviving 1997 card in the held record -- a named gap, not silently thinned.
notes: The fed's own relaunch account: originally owned by a prior operator (real name withheld per the privacy rule), the FASW merged with the EWA at Superstar Summit (a best-of-seven series) in April 1996, then relaunched independently 1 Jan 1997 under a new operator (real name withheld per the privacy rule). Third-party sightings elsewhere in the held record (see this wing's own epitaph) place the relaunched FASW's on-camera debut at the EWA's own New Year's Bash the same night, and a masked FASW representative in an EWA special as late as 13 May 1997 -- but no FASW-authored card of its own survives.

name: FASW
notes: The fed's own recruitment ad, naming ten roster characters headed by champion Hellshock. This wing's first-ever servable primary-source document.

name: SUPERSTAR SUMMIT-TOMORROW!

date.source: The post's own Usenet dateline (event: 7 April 1996, per the post's own "TOMORROW").

notes: Preview for Superstar Summit, the interfed best-of-nine series against the EWA -- this wing's own already-documented closure event. Announces the FASW World Title match (Hellshock (champ) vs. Gunnar "The Grizzly" Gaines; outcome not in the held record) and the FASW/EWA TV Title Unification Match (Psychrobat vs. Super Scott, resolved on the following document).

name: SUPERSTAR SUMMIT (Pt. 2)

date.source: The post's own Usenet dateline; the match itself aired at the interfed event, in progress at the time of the linked preview.

notes: The FASW/EWA TV Championship Unification Match: Psychrobat (FASW) defeats Super Scott (EWA, unminted -- see this wing's enrichment note) to become the first-ever Unified TV Champion, putting the FASW up two matches to none in the best-of-nine Superstar Summit series. The primary-source result behind this wing's own already-documented closure narrative.
